name: minimax-h3
notes_low: MiniMax H3 omni-modal video+audio: fl2va + ref2va pruned int8 diffusion (~21 GB each), Qwen3-VL 32B int8 TE (~27 GB), video+audio VAEs. Requires ComfyUI 0.30+. NVFP4_SUPPORTED=true swaps TE to official nvfp4_awq. Large download (~75 GB). Native stereo audio T2V/I2V/R2V.
notes_high: Same stack with pruned BF16 diffusion (~40 GB each fl2va/ref2va) for higher quality on high-VRAM hosts. TE remains int8 unless NVFP4_SUPPORTED=true (official Qwen3-VL nvfp4_awq). Requires ComfyUI 0.30+.
description: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3) open-weights video pack: text/image/reference-to-video with native stereo audio via Comfy-Org repackaged weights.
